desc:
🧪 Welcome to Voxel Experiments! A blocky ragdoll physics sandbox where every hit matters. What could go wrong?

🧟 Grab, drag, throw and fling zombies, skeletons, creepsters and villagers. Watch them stumble, limp and crawl!
💉 Inject mutations, transform ragdolls and discover strange effects.
💥 Use superpowers, crush test dummies and experiment with reactive ragdoll physics.
⚔️ Shoot, slice and punch with guns, swords, bows and experimental gear.
⛏️ Mine, build and destroy! Create traps and trigger TNT explosions.
👥 Multiplayer chaos—experiment with friends or make them the test subjects!

🎮 PC, Mobile & Console
👍 Like and favorite for more blocky experiments!
